translations.web: Remember me, Yahweh, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,
translations.bsb: Remember me, O LORD, in Your favor to Your people; visit me with Your salvation,
translations.kjv: Remember me, O LORD, with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;
